archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite & Precision) / SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST

rules: Use 'Manrope' for all UI headings, toolbars, and layer titles (tight tracking).
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for secondary text, timestamps, and data.
Headings should max out at text-2xl in the editor to save space, keeping a dense, professional UI.

surfaces: Editor UI should feel like a 'Tactical' command center.
Use flat solid backgrounds with sharp 1px borders (`border-white/10`) to separate the canvas, timeline, and toolbars.
No glassmorphism inside the editor screen to prevent visual distraction.
Canvas area should have a checkerboard pattern background to indicate transparency behind the banner.
shadows: Keep shadows minimal. Use 1px inner strokes instead of drop shadows to define active elements.

layouts.global: Mobile-first, strict 100vh layout with NO page scrolling. Internal sections scroll independently.

home_screen.structure: Standard scrolling page. Top nav, hero 'New Project' button, followed by Bento Grid of templates.
home_screen.grid: Bento layout for templates (mix of col-span-2 and row-span-2 to represent different aspect ratios like 16:9, 1:1, 9:16).

editor_screen.structure: Flex column, full height (h-screen w-full overflow-hidden).

sections.name: Top Bar
sections.content: Back button, Project Title, Undo/Redo, Export Button.

sections.name: Canvas (Preview Area)
sections.content: Checkerboard background. Centered banner artboard with mock transform handles (dots on corners). Should scale to fit available space.

sections.name: Contextual Toolbar
sections.content: Horizontal scrolling list of tools. Changes based on selection (e.g., if Text is selected -> Font, Style, Color). If nothing is selected -> Add Media, Text, Elements.

sections.name: Timeline Area
sections.content: Multi-track timeline. Left column for track types/visibility toggles. Right area horizontally scrollable. Vertical white line for Playhead. Tracks are colored bars (blue for video/bg, yellow for text, etc.).

rules: Use framer-motion for tool transitions and bottom sheet animations.
Timeline scrubbing (mocked) should have zero transition delay for snappy feel.
All buttons must have a `:hover` and `:active` state.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., 'data-testid="export-btn"').
Ensure contrast ratio is > 4.5:1 for text on dark backgrounds.

image_urls.description: Abstract gradient to serve as a mock banner background in the editor.
Gradient background for template cards on the Home screen.

components.name: TimelineTrack
components.description: A horizontal bar representing a layer. Needs trim handles on the edges.
components.classes: h-10 rounded-md flex items-center px-2 relative group overflow-hidden border border-white/20

components.name: Playhead
components.description: Vertical white line indicating current time.
components.classes: absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-white z-10 before:content-[''] before:absolute before:-top-3 before:-left-1.5 before:w-3.5 before:h-3.5 before:bg-white before:rounded-sm

setup: Install required icons: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` or use `lucide-react`.
Ensure fonts Manrope and IBM Plex Sans are imported in index.css.
Build a dark mode UI primarily. Avoid bright backgrounds in the editor.
implementation_steps: 1. Build the Home screen with a 'Recent Projects' list and a 'Templates' grid.
2. Build the Editor layout wrapper: flex-col, h-screen, overflow-hidden.
3. Implement the Top Navigation bar with Export button.
4. Implement the Canvas area with a mock artboard (e.g., aspect-video) centered in the available space.
5. Implement the Contextual Toolbar (middle). Provide a mock state toggle: 'clip_selected' vs 'nothing_selected' to show different tools.
6. Implement the Timeline at the bottom. Render 3 mock tracks: Video/BG, Text, and Overlay. Include a playhead.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use crisp 1px borders instead of heavy shadows for a professional tool aesthetic.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Prioritize mobile-first view (stacking vertically), but ensure it scales well on desktop (canvas expands, timeline stays fixed height at bottom).
Add interactive hover states to all timeline clips and toolbar buttons.
